IYENGAR PRACTICE

Sequence timer

PWA v1.2 · Configure here. During practice the timer uses a fixed, non-scrolling screen.

Audio

The pose name is spoken first. The hold clock starts only after this extra delay.

Android voice note: some phones — including some Samsung/Chrome combinations — show several voice names here but route all of them through the same installed text-to-speech engine. If every choice sounds identical, that is a browser/Android limitation rather than a timer setting. The editable “Say” spelling is therefore still used for Sanskrit pronunciation. A later version can support recorded human pose-name audio.

Your sequence

For each pose you can set hold time, repetitions, and whether it runs on right + left sides. The single “Delay after pose name” setting controls the preparation countdown before each hold. “Say” is the phonetic text spoken aloud. Reorder with ↑ / ↓.

Level 1 pose library

Tap a pose to append it to your current sequence. Family names follow the RIMYI Level 1 syllabus. Timing values are only editable timer defaults, not prescribed RIMYI timings.

Presets

Install on phone

When this page is hosted over HTTPS (for example with GitHub Pages), Chrome can install it as an app on your home screen and the Screen Wake Lock API can operate in the secure context it requires.

Build: PWA v1.2

During practice the app requests the Screen Wake Lock API and also uses an active-media fallback. For reliable keep-awake behavior on Samsung, install and open this PWA from its HTTPS address rather than opening the HTML as a local file.
